title: 第6章 你我有缘，送你礼物很合理吧？
slug: 神豪从收留精神小妹开始日进斗金
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“臭泥，睁大你的眼睛给我好好看清楚！这可是香奈儿，大品牌！”

丸子展示刚买的口红，脸上抑制不住的自豪，“哼，我哥给我买的！”

香菜闻言，赶忙也送上一记“助攻”。

“臭泥，看到了吗？最新款的圣罗兰，卖四百多呢！哼，也是我哥给我买的！”

末了，二女不忘杀人诛心，来上这么一句：

“臭泥，话说有人给你买吗？”

“你，你们......”

紫发小妹气得嘴角一阵抽搐。

眼中更是泛起晶莹泪花，快要哭了。

不是被气的，而是被酸到了。

被她崩过的老登没有一百，也有八十。

可人家老登顶多给个十几二十块，买份宵夜。

根本不愿多花一分钱。

而这，还是建立在看腿的基础之上。

至于花几百块给她买化妆品，想都不要想！

就在这时，紫毛小妹眼珠一转，冷笑道：

“呵呵，男人给你们花钱，图什么？”

“还不是图你们年轻漂亮的身体！”

“小心啊，被人用完就扔！”

说着，赵安妮撩了撩额头前的几缕秀发，漫不经心地看着丸子二人。

像是重新找回了上风。

“哼，你少在这给哥泼脏水！”

香菜怒声怼了回去，“我看你就是吃不到葡萄，硬说葡萄皮酸。”

赵安妮闻言，双手抱胸，“我话已经说完，信不信随你。”

“哥是好男人，要是哥想要走到那一步，我也是会积极配合的。”丸子突然道。

说完，她顺势朝江辰抛了一个媚眼。

赵安妮语塞。

江辰则是像被一道闪电击中。

这大概就是童颜巨......

啊不，童言无忌！

他转念一想。

赵安妮这番话，确实有股硬说葡萄皮酸的味道。

但，也确实是给丸子二人提了个醒。

由此可见，这妹子心肠不坏。

最关键的是，还是A级精神小妹……

“你叫什么名字？”江辰开口问道。

“赵安妮。”

赵安妮脱口而出。

刚回答完，她就愣住了：为什么我要回答一个陌生大叔的提问？

“我叫江辰，是丸子和香菜的朋友。”

江辰淡笑道：“放心好了，我不是什么坏人。”

赵安妮清冷一笑，心中暗道：你见过哪个坏人，会主动承认自己是坏人的？

紧接着，她上上下下打量了江辰一番。

看不出眼前这个不修边幅的男人，穿着一身地摊货，到底有什么钞能力。

不过嘛，却是有股邻家大哥哥的亲和力。

江辰的脸，除了有些胡子拉渣外，细看之下，还是有几分小帅的！

“交个朋友？”江辰试探性地问道。

闻言，赵安妮柳眉微蹙。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Xinni, open your eyes and let me see clearly! This is Chanel, a big brand!"

Wanzi showed off the lipstick he just bought, with uncontrollable pride on his face, "Humph, my brother bought it for me!"

Hearing this, Xiangcai quickly gave an "assist" as well.

"Smelly mud, have you seen it? The latest model of Saint Laurent costs more than 400! Huh, my brother bought it for me too!"

In the end, the two women did not forget to kill people and punish their hearts, so they said this:

"Smelly mud, by the way, does anyone buy it for you?"

"You, you..."

The purple-haired girl was so angry that the corners of her mouth twitched.

There were even more sparkling tears in his eyes, and he was about to cry.

Not angry, but annoyed.

The number of Lao Deng who had been broken by her was not only 100, but also 80.

But people always give me an extra ten or twenty yuan at the top to buy a midnight snack.

Not willing to spend a penny more.

And this is still based on looking at the legs.

As for spending hundreds of dollars to buy cosmetics for her, don’t even think about it!

At this moment, the purple-haired girl rolled her eyes and sneered:

"Haha, why do men spend money on you?"

"I'm not just looking at your young and beautiful bodies!"

"Be careful, throw it away after you use it!"

As she spoke, Zhao Anni brushed a few strands of hair in front of her forehead and looked at Wanzi and the two casually.

It's like he has regained the upper hand.

"Hmph, stop throwing dirty water on me here!"

Xiangcai yelled back angrily, "I think you just can't eat grapes, so you insist that the grape skins are sour."

Hearing this, Zhao Anni crossed her arms and said, "I've finished speaking. It's up to you whether you believe it or not."

"Brother is a good man. If he wants to go that far, I will actively cooperate." Maruko suddenly said.

After saying that, she took advantage of the situation and gave Jiang Chen a wink.

Zhao Anni was speechless.

Jiang Chen felt as if he was struck by lightning.

This is probably Tong Yanju...

Ah no, Tong Yan Wuji!

He then thought about it.

Zhao Anni's words did sound like she was insisting that the grape skins were sour.

However, it did serve as a wake-up call for the two of them.

This shows that this girl has a good heart.

The most important thing is that she is still an A-level spiritual girl...

"What's your name?" Jiang Chen asked.

"Annie Zhao."

Zhao Anni blurted out.

As soon as she finished answering, she was stunned: Why should I answer a question from a strange uncle?

"My name is Jiang Chen, and I am a friend of Wanzi and Xiangcai."

Jiang Chen smiled lightly and said, "Don't worry, I'm not a bad person."

Zhao Anni smiled coldly and thought to herself: Which bad person have you ever seen who would take the initiative to admit that he is a bad person?

Then, she looked Jiang Chen up and down.

He couldn't tell what the slovenly man in front of him, dressed in all kinds of clothes, had what money he had.

However, he has the affinity of the big brother next door.

Jiang Chen's face, apart from being a bit unshaven, is still somewhat handsome if you look closely!

"Make friends?" Jiang Chen asked tentatively.

Hearing this, Zhao Anni frowned slightly.
